n_vs_d_note: n = windows scored, d = trainable params. n << d is UNDERPOWERED BY CONSTRUCTION, not a negative result.
tier: T1 self-action open loop (planner rolls its own plan from measured state at t0). NOT closed loop.

longitudinal.target_speed_acc_note: fraction of the 11976 horizon STEPS (not windows) whose |speed error| is within the band. Bands are PROPOSED reporting tolerances, not a gate.

ego_progress.t0_axis_gt_self_ratio_note: what the GROUND TRUTH scores under pseudosim's published t0-axis reading. 1.0 means the windows are straight; below 1.0 is the CURVATURE CONFOUND — the human charged for under-progress it did not commit, and an arm that drives straighter than the human rewarded for it.
ego_progress.definition: along-track distance covered / the human's, both projected on the human's own final-displacement direction; dt-invariant; <1 = under-drives, >1 = over-drives; GT scores exactly 1.0 by construction
ego_progress.published_motivation: arXiv 2605.00066 — Ego Progress alone rho=0.83 vs closed-loop Driving Score while traditional L2 gives rho=-0.36 (p=0.43, n=8, NO CI). Direction only; those magnitudes are NOT a target.

longitudinal.rate_scaling_note: speed ~ 1/dt, accel ~ 1/dt^2. Numbers computed with a wrong dt are off by those powers; along_* are dt-invariant.

distance_keeping.gap_convention: rig-origin to lead rear face (along - size_x/2); NOT bumper-to-bumper
distance_keeping.censoring_note: 272 of 800 windows never close on the lead and are censored at TTC_CAP_S=30.0s. The mean is over censored data — quote n_closing beside it, never the mean alone.

0-1.time_gap_caveat: this band straddles MIN_SPEED_MPS=0.5 m/s; a time gap is UNDEFINED at standstill and is NaN there, so n_time_gap < n_with_lead by construction. Never read the gap here as a following behaviour.

anti_echo.ruling: Sayed 2026-08-16: v0 is ADMISSIBLE as a planner input (measured present state, not the future) PROVIDED the planner is shown not to be 'just outputting v0 as longitudinal plan'. See Project Steering/V6F_PLANNER_DESIGN.md §1.4.
anti_echo.v0_provenance: win['lead']['speeds'] — the lead block's time-gap denominator, which IS the ego speed at t0

holdv0_baseline.verdict_reason: no episode ids were supplied, so no separation was established. The ruling's condition is UNDISCHARGED, which is not the same as failed — see the per-metric `reason`.
holdv0_baseline.admissible_def: ⛔ Sayed 2026-08-16: no longitudinal claim is admissible until the planner BEATS hold-v0, SEPARATED, on the LONGITUDINAL family. This bit is that condition, evaluated on speed_mae_mps.

speed_mae_mps.what: mean |speed error| over the horizon, m/s (PRIMARY — the binding rule's target-speed accuracy)
speed_mae_mps.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

along_abs_m.what: |along-track position error| at the final horizon step, m — the POSITIONAL consequence of the speed plan; dt-invariant
along_abs_m.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

target_speed_miss_1mps.what: fraction of horizon steps whose |speed error| exceeds 1.0 m/s (1 - target_speed_acc.within_1_mps)
target_speed_miss_1mps.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

holdv0_baseline.estimator: paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap (taniteval.ci) — ⛔ NOT overlapping_holdout_se, which is anti-conservative AND biases the point estimate
holdv0_baseline.baseline: hold-v0: along = v0 * t, lateral = 0, zero commanded acceleration. 0 parameters, 0 vision, 0 training.
holdv0_baseline.\u26a0\ufe0f_scope: hold-v0 is a STRAIGHT line and is the LONGITUDINAL floor ONLY. Beating it says nothing about lateral or tactical quality, and it must never be used to judge a turn — for that the floor family is driving.FLOORS (cv/holdv0/ctrv).

copy_detector.verdict_reason: echo_index_excess +0.0000 < 0.2: the arm is not measurably flatter than the human on these windows. ⚠️ CLEAN here is NOT an admissibility verdict — that is holdv0_baseline's job. This detector can only refute a copy, never establish skill.
copy_detector.echo_index_def: fraction of windows with r(along, hold-v0) >= 0.999 AND mean |commanded accel| <= 0.1 m/s^2, JOINTLY. A pure hold-v0 planner scores exactly 1.0. Reported beside the GT's own value because most of this corpus genuinely is cruising; the EXCESS is the read.
copy_detector.r_alone_is_not_the_detector: ⛔ both profiles are monotone ramps from the origin, so ANY forward-moving plan correlates ~1 with hold-v0 — a hard-braking planner still scores r ~0.99. r is a COMPONENT of echo_index, never a verdict on its own.
copy_detector.dev_ratio_def: RMS(speed_arm - v0) / RMS(speed_gt - v0). 0.0 = the arm commands NOTHING while the human did; 1.0 = it commands the same magnitude (says nothing about the sign — that is dev_r).
copy_detector.dev_r_def: Pearson r between (speed_arm - v0) and (speed_gt - v0) pooled over every (window, step) — the correlation of the DEPARTURE from the echo. A pure hold-v0 planner has a nil departure, so this is UNDEFINED (dev_r_degenerate=true), which IS the signature. ⛔ The degeneracy gate is PHYSICAL (RMS <= 0.001 m/s), not `== 0`: the geometry recovers speed from norm(diff(positions))/dt and leaves a ~1.9e-06 m/s float32 residue, which an exact test correlated into a spurious dev_r = -0.0133 for a PURE ECHO.
copy_detector.echo_frac_where_human_acted_def: of the 1435 windows where the human's own speed departed from v0 by >= 0.5 m/s RMS, the fraction on which the arm nevertheless stayed within 0.1 m/s of v0. The discriminating subset: holding was demonstrably the wrong answer and the arm held anyway.

shuffle_control.reason: no shuffled-v0 re-run supplied. This control needs a SECOND forward pass of the model with v0 permuted across windows — it cannot be computed from a banked dump. stack/scripts/probe_latent_state.py — collect_grid(..., speed_echo_control=True) at line 578 permutes b['pose_last'][:, 3] across the batch (same frames, same recorded actions, WRONG speed scalar); CLI flag --speed-echo-control at line 775; already wired by stack/ops/pbattery_watcher.py:80. This is the machinery that produced the P1 speed-echo row (R2 0.995 -> -0.72). Re-run the planner under it and pass the resulting waypoints as win['pred_v0shuffled'] (+ win['v0_shuffled']). Not running it is a WORK ITEM, not a pass.
shuffle_control.producer: stack/scripts/probe_latent_state.py — collect_grid(..., speed_echo_control=True) at line 578 permutes b['pose_last'][:, 3] across the batch (same frames, same recorded actions, WRONG speed scalar); CLI flag --speed-echo-control at line 775; already wired by stack/ops/pbattery_watcher.py:80. This is the machinery that produced the P1 speed-echo row (R2 0.995 -> -0.72). Re-run the planner under it and pass the resulting waypoints as win['pred_v0shuffled'] (+ win['v0_shuffled']).
shuffle_control.how_to_supply: win['pred_v0shuffled'] [n,H,2] (+ optionally win['v0_shuffled'] [n]; when absent the permutation is regenerated with shuffle_v0(v0, seed) and the seed is stamped)

copy_detector.verdict_reason: echo_index_excess +0.0000 < 0.2: the arm is not measurably flatter than the human on these windows. ⚠️ CLEAN here is NOT an admissibility verdict — that is holdv0_baseline's job. This detector can only refute a copy, never establish skill.
copy_detector.echo_index_def: fraction of windows with r(along, hold-v0) >= 0.999 AND mean |commanded accel| <= 0.1 m/s^2, JOINTLY. A pure hold-v0 planner scores exactly 1.0. Reported beside the GT's own value because most of this corpus genuinely is cruising; the EXCESS is the read.
copy_detector.r_alone_is_not_the_detector: ⛔ both profiles are monotone ramps from the origin, so ANY forward-moving plan correlates ~1 with hold-v0 — a hard-braking planner still scores r ~0.99. r is a COMPONENT of echo_index, never a verdict on its own.
copy_detector.dev_ratio_def: RMS(speed_arm - v0) / RMS(speed_gt - v0). 0.0 = the arm commands NOTHING while the human did; 1.0 = it commands the same magnitude (says nothing about the sign — that is dev_r).
copy_detector.dev_r_def: Pearson r between (speed_arm - v0) and (speed_gt - v0) pooled over every (window, step) — the correlation of the DEPARTURE from the echo. copy_detector.echo_frac_where_human_acted_def: of the 1435 windows where the human's own speed departed from v0 by >= 0.5 m/s RMS, the fraction on which the arm nevertheless stayed within 0.1 m/s of v0. The discriminating subset: holding was demonstrably the wrong answer and the arm held anyway.

speed_mae_mps.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

along_abs_m.what: |along-track position error| at the final horizon step, m — the POSITIONAL consequence of the speed plan; dt-invariant
along_abs_m.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

target_speed_miss_1mps.what: fraction of horizon steps whose |speed error| exceeds 1.0 m/s (1 - target_speed_acc.within_1_mps)
target_speed_miss_1mps.reason: no per-window episode id, so the episode-cluster bootstrap cannot be formed. The point delta is real; the SEPARATION the ruling requires is not established. Pass win['eid']. ⛔ A combination of two single-arm intervals in quadrature is NOT a substitute — the two arms are scored on the same windows and are not independent.

holdv0_baseline.estimator: paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap (taniteval.ci) — ⛔ NOT overlapping_holdout_se, which is anti-conservative AND biases the point estimate
holdv0_baseline.baseline: hold-v0: along = v0 * t, lateral = 0, zero commanded acceleration. 0 parameters, 0 vision, 0 training.
holdv0_baseline.\u26a0\ufe0f_scope: hold-v0 is a STRAIGHT line and is the LONGITUDINAL floor ONLY. Beating it says nothing about lateral or tactical quality, and it must never be used to judge a turn — for that the floor family is driving.FLOORS (cv/holdv0/ctrv).

copy_detector.verdict_reason: echo_index_excess +0.0000 < 0.2: the arm is not measurably flatter than the human on these windows. ⚠️ CLEAN here is NOT an admissibility verdict — that is holdv0_baseline's job. This detector can only refute a copy, never establish skill.
copy_detector.echo_index_def: fraction of windows with r(along, hold-v0) >= 0.999 AND mean |commanded accel| <= 0.1 m/s^2, JOINTLY. A pure hold-v0 planner scores exactly 1.0. Reported beside the GT's own value because most of this corpus genuinely is cruising; the EXCESS is the read.
copy_detector.r_alone_is_not_the_detector: ⛔ both profiles are monotone ramps from the origin, so ANY forward-moving plan correlates ~1 with hold-v0 — a hard-braking planner still scores r ~0.99. r is a COMPONENT of echo_index, never a verdict on its own.
copy_detector.dev_ratio_def: RMS(speed_arm - v0) / RMS(speed_gt - v0). 0.0 = the arm commands NOTHING while the human did; 1.0 = it commands the same magnitude (says nothing about the sign — that is dev_r).
copy_detector.dev_r_def: Pearson r between (speed_arm - v0) and (speed_gt - v0) pooled over every (window, step) — the correlation of the DEPARTURE from the echo. A pure hold-v0 planner has a nil departure, so this is UNDEFINED (dev_r_degenerate=true), which IS the signature. ⛔ The degeneracy gate is PHYSICAL (RMS <= 0.001 m/s), not `== 0`: the geometry recovers speed from norm(diff(positions))/dt and leaves a ~1.9e-06 m/s float32 residue, which an exact test correlated into a spurious dev_r = -0.0133 for a PURE ECHO.
copy_detector.echo_frac_where_human_acted_def: of the 1435 windows where the human's own speed departed from v0 by >= 0.5 m/s RMS, the fraction on which the arm nevertheless stayed within 0.1 m/s of v0. The discriminating subset: holding was demonstrably the wrong answer and the arm held anyway.

shuffle_control.reason: no shuffled-v0 re-run supplied. This control needs a SECOND forward pass of the model with v0 permuted across windows — it cannot be computed from a banked dump. stack/scripts/probe_latent_state.py — collect_grid(..., speed_echo_control=True) at line 578 permutes b['pose_last'][:, 3] across the batch (same frames, same recorded actions, WRONG speed scalar); CLI flag --speed-echo-control at line 775; already wired by stack/ops/pbattery_watcher.py:80. This is the machinery that produced the P1 speed-echo row (R2 0.995 -> -0.72). Re-run the planner under it and pass the resulting waypoints as win['pred_v0shuffled'] (+ win['v0_shuffled']). Not running it is a WORK ITEM, not a pass.
shuffle_control.producer: stack/scripts/probe_latent_state.py — collect_grid(..., speed_echo_control=True) at line 578 permutes b['pose_last'][:, 3] across the batch (same frames, same recorded actions, WRONG speed scalar); CLI flag --speed-echo-control at line 775; already wired by stack/ops/pbattery_watcher.py:80. This is the machinery that produced the P1 speed-echo row (R2 0.995 -> -0.72). Re-run the planner under it and pass the resulting waypoints as win['pred_v0shuffled'] (+ win['v0_shuffled']).
shuffle_control.how_to_supply: win['pred_v0shuffled'] [n,H,2] (+ optionally win['v0_shuffled'] [n]; when absent the permutation is regenerated with shuffle_v0(v0, seed) and the seed is stamped)
